authorization: O dono confirmou a harmonia dos conceitos e a necessidade de revisão conjunta do roster. Depois rejeitou a estética da prancha frame00, apontando recorte sujo no Joe, morfologia atarracada/chibi nos demais e agrupamento de cor poluído; pediu que esses critérios sejam curados como perícia do agente canônico.

lessons.lesson: Em roster, compare concepts/model sheets e sprites juntos antes de aprovar uma nova folha. Registre escala e relações, mas trate-as como eixo separado de anatomia humana, biotipo, recorte, agrupamento cromático e acabamento. Declare escopo de cada referência: Hayato/Kenseiden é régua de acabamento/cluster; Joe Musashi é régua de proporção humana esguia e massa dos membros. Mantenha identidade e paleta de cada jogo, use clusters materiais coerentes e rejeite chibi/membros atarracados, halo ou poluição de cor. O audit mede dimensões e também registra pass/fail/pending dos eixos visuais; a decisão artística é humana.
lessons.root_cause: A prancha frame00 v1 era marcada preliminary_visual_review_only e misturava folhas candidatas, fontes de escalas distintas e concept refs antigas. A montagem alinhava baselines e ampliava os pixels, mas não definia os tamanhos relativos aprovados nem bloqueava diferenças visuais: Golden Axe aparecia 78x88 diante de Alis 60x73; Dr Social era 44x81 e parecia menor que Joe 62x80; Landau 63x87 divergia em escala/acabamento; Alis 60x73 e J.J. 63x76 tinham leitura chibi. A folha Golden Axe v1 ainda antecedia o conceito v2 aprovado. Na revisão seguinte, a faixa dimensional passou, mas a estética foi rejeitada: a régua de escala não bloqueava morfologia atarracada/chibi; o Joe foi usado como âncora corporal sem validar seu recorte; e valores RGB conformes à paleta foram tratados como evidência suficiente de pintura limpa, embora a distribuição de clusters ainda parecesse poluída.

owner_constraints: Golden Axe Warrior <= Alis in visible height.
Dr Social must read at least as large as Joe Musashi while staying lean.
Landau design remains approved, but rendering technique/scale must harmonize with Hayato.
Alis and J.J. must not read chibi.
Roster-wide concept and sprite comparison is a recurring attention area.
evidence.audit_result: needs_revision; source measurements confirm Golden Axe exceeds Alis by 15 px and misses its 72–74 px target; Dr Social width 44 px is below its 50–58 px working band; Alis and Landau miss their height bands. Dr Social and Joe differ only 1 px in height, showing that width/morphology contributes to the perceived size gap.
evidence.candidate_audit_status: v1: numeric dimensions/relations pass; subsequently rejected by owner on aesthetics. Historical report only.
new_measurable_relations: Golden Axe Warrior <= Alis in visible height
Dr Social ~= Joe Musashi in visible height (<=3 px difference)
Dr Social ~= Joe Musashi in visible width (<=8 px difference)
evidence.width_band_revision: Broad width bands account for whole opaque bounds including weapons, shields, cape and hair; body build/chibi read remains a human visual axis.

owner_review_followup_2026_10_04.decision: aesthetic_rejected; scale comparison and general palette direction retained
owner_observations: Joe Musashi has dirty/haloed cutout edges and repeats a previously curated defect.
Other characters read stocky/chibi, with wider limbs and less convincing human face/body proportions than Joe.
Some sprite conversions have color pollution and lost the cleaner painting/cluster quality of the earlier concepts, despite generally correct palette values.
direction: Joe is the lean human morphology anchor only; do not copy his cutout flaw.
Hayato/Kenseiden remains the pixel-finish and cluster anchor.
Preserve per-game SMS palette entries while simplifying and grouping color by material.
A new proposal must pass explicit recorded axes for morphology, limb mass, cutout, palette clusters, shared finish and native-size readability.
owner_review_followup_2026_10_04.candidate_pixels_modified: false; board v2 is a review-status rendering of the same candidate frame sources

art_direction_study_v1.status: new lean-morphology direction for owner evaluation; not palette-validated or approved sprite art

evidence.art_direction_cutout_rejected: ImageGen transparent edit produced visible colored fringe; recorded as a negative cutout example and excluded from proposals.

lessons.limits: The audit measures bbox and declared size relations and records the reviewer’s visual decisions; it does not automatically classify anatomy, chibi read, clean style, material truth or palette-cluster quality. Width includes equipment/hair and is only occupancy. A registered visual fail blocks the candidate; only a new owner review can clear it. Frame00 does not approve animation, integration or ROM.

note_ids.mastery: Roster review records scale and per-axis visual pass/fail/pending. Hayato is finish/cluster anchor; Joe is lean morphology anchor only. Correct palette values do not prove clean clustering or cutout; owner rejection remains binding until a revised source passes a fresh shared board review.
